reviews.comment: Great professor! In-class assignments are 1 or 2 questions that are leniently graded. Readings, however, are long. 3 non-cumulative exams that aren't really hard. The exam questions were so straightforward that I found it hard to convince myself that he wasn't trying to trick us (He really wasn't).
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: A very nice professor who is very considerate of everyone. Class is pretty easy where you have a class question every class, but its graded very lightly and is an opinionated question. Exams are simple if you study.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is a very personable and great professor and human being! He will make you feel seen and cared for, all while maintaining the ultimate goal of education. Would definitely recommend him to anyone who is in the Anthropology field or just needs a credit!
